The condition of %1$s compares %2$s (%3$s) and %4$s (%5$s), which are not of one type.

The condition of %1$s puts a field on its left: {\"field\": …}.
The condition of %1$s compares columns of the row or written values: a variable is read as a column of a grid.
The condition of %1$s reads a formula per entry, which only a variable reads.

A condition judged once: {\"left\": side, \"op\": ..., \"right\": side}, each side a term, {\"constant\": ...}, {\"variable\": \"id\"} or {\"reading\": {\"selection\", \"field\"?, \"reduction\"}}; right is a pair of sides for between, absent for absent and present. A constant is a value of the other side\'s type, a date or a duration as everywhere (Part E), never in milliseconds.

A condition on the value entered in each attempt: {\"op\": ..., \"right\": side}; the app writes left, the entered field. A side is {\"constant\": ...}, {\"variable\": \"id\"} or {\"reading\": ...}; right is a pair for between, absent for absent and present. A constant is a value of the entered field\'s type, a date or a duration as everywhere (Part E), never in milliseconds.

A condition on each row drawn: {\"left\": side, \"op\": ..., \"right\": side}, each side a column of the row, {\"field\": \"kcal\"}, or a written value, {\"constant\": ...}, of the type of the column on the other side, a date or a duration as everywhere (Part E), never in milliseconds; right is a pair of sides for between, absent for absent and present.
{\"constant\": ...}, a written value, a date or a duration as everywhere (Part E)

{\"reading\": {\"selection\", \"field\"?, \"reduction\"}}, a field of a tool reduced across its entries, counted without a field; its selection\'s period is relative to the instant read, and without one it reads the period the context gives

{\"reading\": {\"selection\": {\"target\": {\"kind\": \"ENTRY\", \"id\"}}, \"field\", \"reduction\": \"LAST\"}}, a file field of one entry followed, holding a single file of the kinds taken, read again at each use
Entries of one tool: {\"target\": {\"kind\": \"TOOL_INSTANCE\", \"id\"}, \"filters\"?: [conditions on each entry], \"fields\"?: [paths kept]}; its period is given elsewhere.

The order of the entries of the selection \'%1$s\': keys applied one after the other, each a field of its tool (\"name\", \"timestamp\", \"data.number\") and \"asc\" or \"desc\"; empty or absent, the newest first. Entries without a value come last.

A period, {\"start\"?, \"end\"?}, both inclusive, a bound absent for no limit: a fixed instant, or a relative date, {\"relative\": {\"unit\": \"DAY\", \"offset\": -29, \"edge\": \"START\"}} or {\"relative\": \"NOW\"}.

Instants, each a relative date against the moment the setting says, never a fixed one: {\"relative\": {\"unit\": \"HOUR\", \"offset\": -1, \"edge\": \"SAME\"}} for an hour before, {\"relative\": {\"unit\": \"MINUTE\", \"offset\": -15, \"edge\": \"SAME\"}}, {\"relative\": {\"unit\": \"DAY\", \"offset\": -1, \"edge\": {\"at\": \"18:00\"}}} for the day before at 18:00, {\"relative\": \"NOW\"} for the moment itself.

Any server speaking the OpenAI Chat Completions API: Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM, LM Studio, OpenRouter. The address ends before /chat/completions, usually with /v1 (Ollama: https://<host>/v1). Only https: plain http would send your data in clear. A server at home can get a certificate through tailscale serve or a reverse proxy such as Caddy. The model has to be of the 30B class or larger (Gemma 4 31B, gpt-oss-120b, DeepSeek): a smaller one gets lost in the app\'s commands.
Output forcing: the server holds the model to valid JSON, or to the exact schema of the answer. Small models need it most; a server that does not support the level chosen answers an error.
